backgroundZh: 天宝十一载（752），颜真卿为长安千福寺多宝塔书碑。塔以碑传，这方唐石今藏西安碑林。
background: A Tang stele of 752 written by Yan Zhenqing, recording the Duobao Pagoda at the Qianfu Temple in Chang’an. Held at the Xi’an Beilin Museum.
